info.title: Warden API
info.description: Every response is an envelope {data, error, meta}. Field names are snake_case, timestamps RFC 3339 (UTC), ids UUIDs unless noted. Unknown JSON fields are rejected with 422. Request bodies are limited to 1 MiB.

version.description: Optimistic lock; send it back on transitions.

id.description: Numeric event id, as a string.
Numeric entry id, as a string.

assignee_id.description: Required (and only allowed) when to = assigned.

expires_at.description: risk_accepted only: required, within (now, now + 180 days].
Approve a risk acceptance only; may only shorten the requested expiry.
